title: How Long Does Google Take to Index a New Page? I Timed 136
meta_description: I timed 136 new pages in Search Console. 95 of 99 showed up by the next day. 37 others waited a median of 18 days, most until I asked.
primary_keyword: how long does it take google to index a new page
secondary_keywords: how long does google take to index a page
how long does it take google to index a new website
discovered currently not indexed how long
does request indexing speed up google indexing
how long to appear in ai overviews

image.takeaway: 95 of 99 pages were shown in Google Search by the next day; 37 that Google missed waited a median of 18 days.
